verdict.rationale: Solid's README says state management is built in through Context and Stores, so global state needs no third-party library (solid-gh-2). It is backed by fine-grained reactive state with automatic dependency tracking (solid-gh-1, solid-gh-10) and a built-in Context primitive (solid-gh-11). A long-term user also reports that state changes stay intuitive on a large product (solid-comm-10). Missing for 10: in-depth first-party documentation of the Store/Context APIs for global state (e.g., nested updates, provider patterns), and independent hands-on corroboration of using Stores specifically for app-wide state.
